MESSAGE FROM
THE CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD
OF DIRECTORS
To Our Esteemed Shareholders, Investors, and Partners,
 
In 2023, the global economy faced significant challenges, 
marked by a sharp GDP growth decline, international trade, 
and investment. Meanwhile, non-performing loans (NPL) 
increased, and inflation remained high. The global economic 
situation affected the Vietnamese economy; however, 
positive trends in the final months of 2023 helped our country 
achieve a full-year economic growth rate of approximately 
5.05%, a relatively high growth compared to many countries 
worldwide and in the region. Inflation was controlled, 
with the average Consumer Price Index (CPI) estimated to 
increase by approximately 3.5%. The overall credit demand 
reached approximately 13.5%, slightly below the targeted 
figure of around 14% set at the beginning of the year. The 
deposits grew by approximately 10.85%, while the liquidity 
faced difficulties mainly within the real estate sector and 
corporate bond market.” Many new directives and policies 
from the Party and the State continued to be implemented 
extensively. The SBV actively and flexibly managed monetary 
policies to stabilize the macroeconomic environment and 
support economic recovery and growth. 
2023 marked a generational transition for MB. With the trust 
of the Central Military Commission, Ministry of National 
Defense, the BOD, and predecessor - former Deputy Minister 
of Defense, former Chairman of MB’s BOD - Lieutenant 
General Le Huu Duc, I was entrusted with the responsibility 
of the Chairman of the BOD; Senior Colonel Pham Nhu Anh 
was appointed as the CEO of MB. Inheriting and continuing 
the values of previous leadership generations, MB continued 
its strategic goal of “Becoming a Digital Corporation, 
a Leading Financial Group.”, With six core values, eight 
strategic directions, and eight well-structured working 
methods, MB aspired to become a sustainable development 
organization that delivers value to customers and happiness 
to employees. With solidarity and consistency in governance 
and management by the BOD, the SB, the BOM, MB Group 
has gradually realized the Development Strategy for the 
2022-2026 period with the following significant results: The 
Group’s PBT reached VND 26,306 billion; The Bank only’s was 
estimated at VND 24,688 billion; the subsidiaries’ reached 
VND 2,046 billion. The bank maintained its position as a 
TOP in key efficiency indicators - ROE was approximately 
25%. MB was fully provisioned and compliant with legal 
regulations. The bank’s position and reputation continued 
to strengthen. MB led in growth, ranked in the Top 3 for 
PBT among commercial banks. MB attracted 6.2 million 
new customers (cumulative customer base surpassed 26.5 
million) with digital transaction rates exceeding 96.7%. 
Besides achieving the business plan, the BOD effectively 
implemented the tasks entrusted in resolutions of the 
2023 GSM and fully exercised the rights of shareholders as 
prescribed by law.
MB made significant contributions to the state budget with 
approximately VND 7.518 trillion, carried out social welfare 
activities, and fulfilled its social responsibilities through more 
than 100 programs, with a total expenditure of approximately 
VND 200 billion. MB launched the HiGreen campaign - “Bình 
Minh Xanh” - the “Participatory CSR” campaign, aiming to 
convey the message of sustainable living, environmental 
care, and community engagement to customers and society.
2024 is unique as MB welcomes its 30th anniversary with even 
more significant challenges and bigger dreams, embodying 
the message of “Move for Big.” It’s also the start of a new 
term for the BOD and the SB for the 2024 - 2029 period. 
Accordingly, MB set specific objectives as follows: Top 3 
banks in terms of efficiency and safety, striving for a PBT 
of VND 30 trillion for the Group, and reaching the milestone 
of serving 30 million customers. MB Bank will implement 
many programs and projects targeting the following groups: 
Country and Community: Move for Big Vietnam; Employees: 
Move for Big Ambition; Customers: Move for Big Generation. 
At the same time, MB will continue to enhance and vigorously 
implement and optimize strategic initiatives under the 
Group’s strategy for the 2022-2026 period, promoting “Group 
synergy.”
Although the road ahead is still full of difficulties, with pressing 
climate change, geopolitical risks, and other emerging 
transition risks, MB is determined to continue researching 
and implementing solutions to indirectly contribute to the 
country’s commitment to achieving net zero emissions by 
2050.
On behalf of the BOD, I would like to sincerely thank the 
support and trust of our esteemed Shareholders, Investors, 
Partners, customers, and especially all the staff of MB who 
have accompanied us over the past years. We hope to 
continue to receive your collaboration, solidarity, and trust 
in the coming year.
Mr. Luu Trung Thai
Chairman of the BOD

LETTER FROM
THE CEO
To Our Esteemed Shareholders, Investors, Partners, and Customers,
As the global economy faced significant challenges 
from the economic downturn in 2023, MB stood firm in 
overcoming difficulties and made breakthroughs in its digital 
transformation strategy. This was evidenced by a substantial 
leap in customer acquisition, which reached 26.5 million by 
2023, an eight-fold increase compared to 2017, making MB 
the bank with the most extensive customer base in Vietnam.
By the end of 2023, MB’s total assets increased by 29% to 
approximately VND 950 trillion; outstanding loans surged by 
over 28.8% to reach VND 615 trillion; the group’s net profit 
exceeded VND 26 trillion.
MB is the leading bank in providing diverse and secure 
services and products, possessing modern information 
technology infrastructure and expanding aggressively into 
new market segments besides the traditional market of 
a commercial bank. Leveraging that advantage, MB has 
integrated BaaS services to businesses from various sectors, 
such as financial services, logistics, and securities, through 
over 600 APIs, making it one of the banks with the most 
diverse APIs. MB’s BaaS is expected to go further and beyond 
as part of our commitment to supporting businesses in their 
digital transformation journey.
In addition, our MB team made efforts to develop MB 
Marketplace to contribute to the transformation of App 
MBBank into a super app with diverse non-bank services 
integrated onto a single platform to serve the daily needs of 
over 20 million users.
In the context of solid digital transformation, MB aims for 
business growth and emphasizes corporate responsibility 
for society and the environment. At the beginning of 2023, 
the bank demonstrated a strong commitment to the ESG 
(Environmental, Social, and Governance) strategy, adhering 
to international measurement standards and centering 
around positive impacts on customers and the environment.
Following the Government’s and the SBV’s direction, MB has 
researched and improved credit policy mechanisms linked 
to environmental and social management, aiming for green 
banking and green credit. This involves providing credit and 
payment services in environmentally friendly sectors.
MB made significant moves in developing green credit, with 
a total value reaching VND 56.829 trillion, an increase of 22% 
compared to 2022. The bank focused on clean, renewable 
energy and industry sectors, clearly reflecting its substantial 
shift towards sustainable financing. MB also digitalized 90% 
of its internal operations, reducing reliance on paperwork 
and aiming for a green working environment, aiming to 
achieve a 100% digitalization ratio.
At the end of 2023, MB launched the Hi-Green campaign, 
a Participatory CSR campaign under the bank’s ESG 
strategy. HiGreen attracted participants to engage in sports 
activities and provided direct support based on accumulated 
volunteering points. Accordingly, for each valid kilometer of 
running or walking, MB will donate VND 3,000 from the group’s 
social charity fund to transform temporary landfill sites into 
community ecological spaces and public playgrounds. After 
about two months, the campaign achieved its goal of VND 
8.1 billion to transform temporary landfill sites into ecological 
playgrounds for the community.
With strong and sustainable development in 2023, MB’s 
brand reputation continues to be affirmed in prestigious 
rankings and awards both domestically and internationally. 
MB is one of the six banks ranked by Forbes magazine as 
the top six listed banks in Vietnam for three consecutive 
years (2021-2023) based on operational efficiency and 
profitability criteria. In addition, MB’s SmartBank automated 
banking model received two international awards from The 
Asset Tripple A Award - Best Digital Branch Project and The 
Global Economics - Digital Transformation Bank of the Year. 
These awards show the bank’s digital transformation and 
customer-centric efforts.
In 2024, MB remains steadfast in its vision for 2026: 
“Becoming a Digital Corporation, a Leading Financial Group” 
with the strategic goal of being “Top 3 in terms of efficiency 
in Vietnam, aiming at the Top in Asia.”
MB’s strategy focuses on customer experience and value- 
added initiatives for customers, thereby adding value to MB. 
Throughout this journey is a consistent governance culture, 
guided by the philosophy of “Customer-centricity” based on 
the following factors:
(1) Customer attraction: Building excellent experiences - 
Understanding customer needs and fulfilling their expectations.
(2) Flexibility and agility: Being agile - Optimizing - Efficiently 
leveraging technology, market, and customer needs.
(3) Group synergy: Connecting the whole Group, building the 
One ID digital experience; with excellent value proposition.
To serve 30 million customers by 2024, achieve a consolidated 
profit of VND 30 trillion, and have total assets of VND 1 
quadrillion, MB is aiming to be a leading bank in digitization 
and a pioneering bank in sustainable development and social 
responsibility. With its big moves and innovative strategy, MB 
is affirming its position in the financial market and is ready 
for new opportunities in the digital banking industry.
Mr. Pham Nhu Anh
Chief Executive Officer

DEVELOPMENT
From a bank with just 25 employees and VND 20 billion of charter capital, after 29 years, MB has transformed itself into a multi-functional 
financial group, constantly accelerating digital transformation, aiming to bring customers the the best experiences. As a member of the Vietnam 
Banking Association, MB has been actively contributing to the development of the banking and financial industry.
On November 4th, 1994, Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB) was established with a 
capital of nearly VND 20 billion, 25 employees, and a single transaction office at 28A Dien 
Bien Phu Street, Hanoi.
The first ten years (1994-2004) were a period for “paving the way” to shape the operating 
motto, determine the business strategy, and define the brand. In 2004, its tenth anniversary, 
total group deposits increased more than 500 times compared to the initial amount, total 
assets reached more than VND 7 trillion, and profits exceeded VND 500 billion. MB opened 
its new headquarters at No. 3 Lieu Giai Street, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi.
From 2005 to 2009, MB implemented a series of comprehensive renewal solutions, 
including expanding operations, developing its network, investing in technology, and 
enhancing overall governance capability.
This period was a solid foundation for MB to actively implement its strategic initiatives 
and become one of the Vietnamese leading financial institutions today. In 2009, MB 
celebrated its 15th anniversary and was awarded the Third-Class Labour Medal by the 
President of Vietnam.
On November 1st, 2011, MB successfully listed MBB shares on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock 
Exchange. This was also a very difficult period of the economy. The banking sector 
implemented a drastic restructuring process. In this context, MB remained stead fast in 
its sustainable and safe development strategy to win the leading position with respect 
to multiple financial indicators, and met its target of winning the position in the Top 3 
joint-stock commercial banks not controlled by the State in 2013.
With those achievements, MB was honored to receive the First-class Labour Medal in 
2014 and the Hero of Labour title in 2015.
During this period, despite facing numerous challenges due to the global Covid-19 
pandemic, MB experienced strong growth, breakthroughs in business activities, and 
successfully rebranded itself in 2019, transforming into a dynamic, youthful bank — 
ranking among the Top 2 most beloved brands. The brand value doubled, rising 127 
ranks compared to 2020, placing it among the Top 300 strongest and most valuable 
global banking brands (according to the Brand Finance Banking 500 report for 2022). 
MB was proud to maintain the Top enterprises with a profit of over VND 10,000 billion 
and the Top 5 banks by quality in Vietnam.
After the period of 2017 - 2021, which laid the groundwork for MB’s digital transformation, in 
the period of 2022-2026, MB continues a more robust digital transformation journey with the 
motto “Digital Acceleration - Customer Attraction - Group Synergy - Safety and Sustainability”. 
In 2022, MB achieved outstanding results with a position in the Top 5 in profits, ranking at the 
Top in Return on Equity, and being among the Top banks in safety and credit quality indicators.
In 2023, MB once again achieved remarkable success, earning prestigious titles and awards: 
Top 3 in profits within the commercial banking system and Top 2 Vietnam’s most valuable 
brand. Furthermore, MB is one of the few banks with the most comprehensive ecosystems and 
the most synchronized digitalization in Vietnam. Digital transformation also achieved many 
significant accomplishments: The App MBBank and BIZ MBBank won numerous prestigious 
awards both domestically and internationally. App Thien Nguyen was honored as a Timely 
Project at the Human Act Prize 2023. The HiGreen campaign was the first Participatory CSR 
campaign organized and sponsored by MB, with significant media influence on the community. 
In 2023, with the trust of the Central Military Commission and the Ministry of National Defense, 
MB successfully implemented the transfer of senior personnel, opening a new chapter for MB and 
continuing the journey towards its vision. MB aims not only to “Become a Digital Corporation, 
a Leading Financial Group” but also a company with a comprehensive ESG strategy, caring 
about the sustainable development of the community, environment, and society.

In 2023, the domestic banking industry demonstrated remarkable resilience despite a series of challenges and significant impacts from the

Domestically, the government and the SBV have proactively issued numerous regulatory changes to stimulate the economy. These

on real estate and bond lending, and the SBV reducing the regulatory interest rate four times in a row by 1.25-2.0% per year, have provided

the end of the previous year.

Market risk is the risk of adverse fluctuations in interest rates, exchange rates, stock prices, and commodity prices on the market, 
which could affect the value of a bank’s financial asset portfolio. It includes Interest rate risk, Foreign exchange risk, Stock price 
risk, and Commodity price risk.
MB developed a market risk management framework that combines the three lines of defense organizational structure with 
internal regulations, models, limits, etc. Market risk was managed through identification, measurement, monitoring, control, and 
reporting under normal conditions and during significant fluctuations in stock prices, commodity prices, exchange rates, and 
interest rates.  Market risk is comprehensively assessed and identified in transactions, products, and the status in MB’s trading 
book, measured, and monitored daily through limits and alert thresholds.

on enhancing and upgrading the market risk measurement and management system. Additionally, MB dedicated significant 
resources to research and implement the stringent Basel III standards.

liquidity risk management, getting closer to international standards.

Risk Management for Sustainable Development
As a financial intermediary in the banking industry and with the perspective that “Green transformation is vital”, MB 
has been and continues implementing comprehensive ESG transformation in its business operations, aligning with 
international standards.
ESG risks include environmental, social, and governance risks that impact the Bank’s key risks (credit, market, liquidity, 
and operational risks) through micro and macro business channels. Therefore, MB manages them according to MB’s 
General Risk Management Framework for other types of risks.
Regarding the risk management mechanism between MB’s core activities and the environment - society:
In 2023, MB implemented and applied regulations on Environmental Risk Management in credit activities (complying 
with Circular 17/2022/TT-NHNN) integrated into the credit granting process. Specific commitments, measures, and 
remediation plans are required for projects with environmental risks. If these are not met, MB reserves the right to 
refuse credit to limit/control projects that may impact the environment and society. Environmental risk assessment is 
integrated into the credit process from proposal, appraisal, and approval to post-disbursement monitoring.  Therefore, 
according to the post-disbursement monitoring schedule, MB assesses compliance with customers’ remediation plans 
and evaluates additional environmental risks (if any).
For Net Zero commitments, MB must assess and develop a direction for evaluating carbon emissions and promote 
financing for customers’/projects’ technological transformation needs. Based on the government’s issuance of the 
Vietnam Taxonomy, MB will find it easier to classify green projects when granting credit.
